name: Annabel Lee
source:
Annabel Lee wakes up on a old ship in the middle of the ocean, surrounded by fog. Suffering from amnesia, with nothing more than the clothes on her back, and a mysterious tarot card in her pocket. A tired looking man, and a strange looking woman wake up next to her, both finding cards in their pockets as well. Annabel must navigate the situation, dealing with two mysterious strangers and  handling a bizarre situation. 

[From [url=https://strawberrybunnz.itch.io/annabel-lee]itch.io[/url]]
